scope: Ten named published records selected for exact-baseline defence-posture enrichment.

prospects.name: Rheinmetall Canada recovery vehicles and lifecycle support
prospects.fitSummary: Rheinmetall Canada is a direct Canadian defence supplier and systems integrator; Canada awarded it contracts for 85 Enhanced Recovery Capability vehicles and initial in-service support, with work centred on the Canadian Armed Forces recovery fleet.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Selected after live-baseline comparison confirmed a material non-duplicative gap.

prospects.name: L3Harris Canada mission systems and fleet support

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Selected after live-baseline comparison confirmed a material non-duplicative gap.
